true.rationale: Source fact-checking determined statement is completely accurate.

mostly-true.rationale: Statement is accurate with minor omission or clarification needed.

half-true.rationale: Statement has factual core but leaves out important nuances or context.

barely-true.rationale: Statement contains element of truth but ignores critical facts to create false impression.

false.rationale: Statement is not accurate and contradicts verified facts.

pants-fire.rationale: Statement is not accurate and makes a ridiculous, completely fabricated claim.
